text: I made a to-do list. Writing it down felt productive enough for one day.
My alarm clock is an optimist. It still believes I will get up on the first ring.
I went for a walk to clear my head. Now my thoughts have better scenery.
I bought a planner to organize my life. First task: find the planner.
I put my phone down to focus. Now I am focused on where I put it.
I am great at saving things for later. Especially tasks.
My code works on my computer. Shall we invite all the users over?
I opened a new tab so I would not forget. Now I have 47 reminders and no idea why.
I made a backup. My next project is remembering where I saved it.
The computer asked me to restart. Finally, advice I can follow.
I fixed one bug and three others appeared. My code has a loyalty program.
I named the folder final. It now contains final-two and actually-final.
I studied for three hours. Two were spent choosing the perfect study playlist.
Our group project has a fantastic name. We are still working on the project part.
I opened my notes and discovered that past me had been writing riddles.
I put the book under my pillow. So far, only the neck pain has transferred.
The deadline is my most reliable motivational speaker.
I cleaned my desk before studying. The desk passed; I am still revising.
We scheduled a meeting to find out why we have no time. It ran long.
My calendar is so full of meetings that I need an appointment to do the work.
The email said “one quick question”. There goes lunch.
I delivered the task early. The reward was another task.
We postponed the planning meeting to plan a better time for it.
I work from home. My commute is one swivel of the chair.
My cat sleeps on the laptop. Apparently the project needed a paws button.
My parrot learned the notification sound. Now my phone pings even when it is off.
My turtle says it is not late; it is appreciating the journey.
The cat preferred the gift box. Five stars for packaging, no comment on the gift.
My dog brought a ball to the meeting. Finally, a clear action item.
The snail moved house. The neighbors did not notice.
